relations.text: 3Mの食品安全事業と統合。Petrifilmは今も3Mの工場で製造
relations.text_en: Combined with 3M's Food Safety business; Petrifilm is still made in 3M plants

source.label: Neogen 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: Other former 3M Food Safety Division ("FSD") products such as Petrifilm product line are currently manufactured within 3M plants in the U.S. and Poland.

relations.text: ゲノム事業をZoetisに1.6億ドルで売却する契約(2026年3月)
relations.text_en: Agreed to sell its Genomics business to Zoetis for $160 million (March 2026)

source.label: Neogen 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: On March 2, 2026, we announced that we had entered into a definitive agreement to sell our Genomics business to Zoetis, Inc. for $160.0 million.

relations.text: 洗浄・消毒剤事業をKersiaに1.217億ドルで売却(2026年5月期)

source.label: Neogen 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: we completed the sale of the Cleaners and Disinfectants ("C&D") business to Kersia Group ("Kersia").
